news.title: Musk’s xAI is being sued over its data center generators. Now, it’s buying $2.8B more.
news.description: Elon Muks's xAI said it will buy $2.8 billion worth of natural gas turbines over the next three years, according to SpaceX's IPO filing.

news.title: Anthropic will pay xAI $1.25 billion per month for compute
news.description: Elon Musk's xAI surprised the AI world when it made a deal to sell compute to Anthropic. Now we know how much it's worth.

news.title: OpenAI claims it solved an 80-year-old math problem — for real this time
news.description: OpenAI claims its reasoning model disproved a geometry conjecture unsolved since 1946 — and this time, the mathematicians who exposed its last embarrassing claim are backing it up.

news.title: IrisGo, a startup backed by Andrew Ng, looks to become the AI desktop buddy you never knew you needed
news.description: Initially billed as an "AI butler," Iris watches what happens on a user's desktop and automatically learns how to do tasks for them, its co-founder says.

news.title: OpenAI barrels toward IPO that may happen in September
news.description: A day after Elon Musk lost his lawsuit that threatened OpenAI's structure, leadership, and finances, OpenAI is reportedly back to prepping for its IPO.

news.title: Zoe Kleinman: Why the AI industry is the real winner of the Musk-Altman trial
news.description: The trial in Oakland, California has helped lift the veil on the AI sector - and the huge egos of the men at the heart of it.

news.title: Literary Prizewinners Are Facing AI Allegations. It Feels Like the New Normal
news.description: Three of five regional winners of the prestigious Commonwealth Short Story Prize are suspected of relying on chatbots. They’re certainly not alone.

news.title: Demis Hassabis Thinks AI Job Cuts Are Dumb
news.description: The CEO of Google DeepMind tells WIRED that companies should use the productivity gains of AI to do more, not lay people off.
